note: Field Menu provides a single field type field_menu (class MenuItemId) with widget field_menu_tree_widget and formatter field_menu_tree_formatter; it has no configure route (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, and defines no plugin type. Field values store menu_title, menu_item_key (menu_name:parent:link), max_depth (0=unlimited) and include_root; field-level settings menu_type_checkbox / menu_type_checkbox_negate restrict which menus the Root selector offers. Medium/hard cases are grounded in a real field_menu field on node.article: introspection reads its machine name and its menu restriction; execution creates a field_menu field on Article verified against FieldStorageConfig/FieldConfig.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module field_menu, what is the machine name of the field type it provides, and the ids of its default widget and default formatter?
evals.expected_output: Field type id: field_menu (label 'Menu item', class MenuItemId). Default widget: field_menu_tree_widget. Default formatter: field_menu_tree_formatter.

evals.prompt: A field_menu field value stores which menu root the tree is rendered from. In what format is that root stored in the menu_item_key column, and what do max_depth=0 and include_root mean?
evals.expected_output: menu_item_key is a colon-separated string menu_name:parent:link produced by core's menu.parent_form_selector. max_depth=0 means unlimited depth; include_root controls whether the selected root link itself is rendered (off = only its children).

evals.prompt: How do you limit which menus a field_menu field lets an editor pick a root from, and how do you invert that list so the named menus are hidden instead? Name the field setting keys.
evals.expected_output: Set the field instance setting menu_type_checkbox to the array of allowed menu machine names (empty = all). Set menu_type_checkbox_negate = TRUE to treat that list as a hide-list (offer every menu except those).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has one field of type field_menu (Menu item). Inspect the live field configuration and give its machine name.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_fmenu_known: FieldStorageConfig node.field_fmenu_known has type field_menu and it is attached to the article bundle.

evals.prompt: The Article content type has a field_menu field named field_fmenu_known. Inspect its live field settings and state which menu(s) its Root selector is restricted to.
evals.expected_output: Its FieldConfig settings have menu_type_checkbox = { main: main } with menu_type_checkbox_negate = FALSE, so the Root selector only offers the 'main' menu.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the field_menu module to add a new field named field_fmenu_task of type field_menu (Menu item) to the Article content type. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create FieldStorageConfig node.field_fmenu_task with type field_menu, then a FieldConfig on the article bundle (e.g. via the Field UI or FieldStorageConfig::create()/FieldConfig::create()).

evals.prompt: I want to embed a sitemap on Article pages. Add a Menu item field (from the field_menu module) called field_fmenu_task to the Article content type so editors can pick a menu branch to display.
evals.expected_output: Same verified end state as field_menu-create-field: a field_menu-type field field_fmenu_task exists on node.article (storage type field_menu + a FieldConfig on article).
